answer.reason: The figure of 86,748,533 megawatthours represents Arizona's total net generation across all producer categories, while 29,277,978 megawatthours is the amount specifically attributed to electric utilities in the EIA table. Therefore, the net generation listed for Electric utilities is 29,277,978 megawatthours.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Arizona Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for Electric utilities?

A. 86,748,533 megawatthours
B. 29,277,978 megawatthours

Source citation: Arizona Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/arizona/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: A
